accepted: ordinary input/output with full token accounting and explicit unknown optional cost
nonzero cache/reasoning subsets plus exact positive cost ticks and two settled turns
zero optional details and zero cache/reasoning
failureSemantics: No canonical success settlement; preserve pending/unknown usage and bounded typed diagnostic; revoke capability; no reusable budget or second physical send.

normalizedModel.cachedTokens: subset of full prompt; never separately added to total
normalizedModel.completionTokens: full output including reasoning subset for supported CLI shape
normalizedModel.costComplete: true only when every settled call supplies compatible exact ticks
normalizedModel.costInUsdTicks: positive exact provider ticks when supplied; missing is unknown, not zero
normalizedModel.reasoningTokens: subset of completion; never separately added to total
normalizedModel.totalTokens: exact prompt + completion for the supported installed CLI projection

terminalFailClosed: additive reasoning outside completion, including public xAI example shape incompatible with installed CLI 1.0.41 projection
unknown additional usage/charge field, nonzero unsupported detail category or source count
cache exceeding prompt or reasoning exceeding completion
zero/oversized cost ticks, mixed priced/unpriced turns, tick arithmetic overflow
legacy missing total after observed usage
